fields.question: Release tooling is for this repo only, so a major release cannot raise a Rhiza inbox item: how does the owner see and sign off a major candidate (e.g. a draft GitHub release the owner publishes, a rhiza request, or a hand-pushed tag)?
fields.statement: A major release candidate is prepared as a draft GitHub release with notes; the owner publishing it is the sign-off, after which the tool tags and pushes
fields.wording: Draft GitHub release: the tool prepares a draft GitHub release with notes, publishing it is the owner sign-off, and the tool then tags and pushes; picked by the owner
